title: Building Resilient Real-Time Microservices with WebSockets & Redis Streams
subtitle: A comprehensive deep dive into horizontal scaling, event-driven streaming, and sub-10ms pub/sub synchronization.
summary: Explore the end-to-end architecture of scaling WebSocket gateways across distributed Node.js nodes using Redis Streams, consumer groups, automatic heartbeat health checks, and edge failover strategies.

seo.metaTitle: Building Resilient Real-Time Microservices with WebSockets & Redis Streams | Fi Amanillah
seo.metaDescription: Explore the end-to-end architecture of scaling WebSocket gateways across distributed Node.js nodes using Redis Streams, consumer groups, automatic heartbeat health checks, and edge failover strategies.

keyTakeaways: Eliminate message loss during worker crashes with Redis Consumer Groups and XACK acknowledgments.
Distribute bi-directional WebSocket connections across horizontal cluster nodes with minimal CPU overhead.
Achieve sub-10ms message propagation latency using zero-copy binary serialization.
Maintain 99.99% availability through automatic client reconnection backoffs and Redis Sentinel failover.
